method: Primary project and maintained guide pages read; no console builds executed.

supports: The maintained initial setup covers all Wii U models and regions, up to 5.5.6 for North American consoles and 5.5.5 for other regions.
A 32 GB SD card is enough for most initial uses.
Use FAT32 and 32 KiB allocation units; do not label the card wiiu.
Merge the complete wiiu folder into the SD root, preserving its environment layout.
WUHB files integrate with the Wii U Menu through the homebrew_on_menu plugin.
Aroma cannot run legacy ELF applications and some older RPX applications, including the legacy RetroArch build.
Tiramisu is archived, but the guide retains a separate legacy application route.
vWii is modded separately from Wii U mode.
Bloopair setup modules use modules/setup, while ordinary WMS modules use modules.
SDCafiine WPS requires WiiUPluginLoaderBackend and ContentRedirectionModule.
The current mod root is sd:/wiiu/sdcafiine/<TITLEID>/<MODPACK>/content or aoc.
Disable SDCafiine in its plugin settings, or use X at Preparing modpack when that screen remains enabled.
Themiify installs local .utheme files from sd:/wiiu/themes and uses StyleMiiU to display them.
It requires original unmodified Wii U Menu NAND files.
Themiify and StyleMiiU load themes from SD instead of replacing Wii U system files.
European menus have additional language resources and tighter theme memory limits; individual themes may need optimization.
The documented recovery routes include moving the installed theme off SD or booting Aroma Safe Mode with L + Up + SELECT.

limits: Guide firmware bounds describe initial setup and do not certify every app or theme on every system version.
No physical Wii U installation, launching, theme application or recovery was performed.
